# NASM

> NASM is the premier provider of evidence-based fitness and nutrition certifications, specializations, and continuing education for fitness professionals seeking to build credible careers and advance their expertise.

NASM (National Academy of Sports Medicine) offers a comprehensive catalog of professional certifications including personal training, nutrition coaching, and specialized credentials across multiple fitness disciplines. The platform serves fitness professionals at all career stages with science-backed programs and continuing education resources.

## Key Topics

- Certified Personal Trainer (CPT)
- Certified Nutrition Coach (CNC)
- Professional Certifications
- Continuing Education Units (CEU)
- Fitness Career Development
- Sports Performance Training
- Specialization Programs
- Evidence-Based Training
- Personal Training Credentials
- Nutrition Certification
- Career Advancement
- NASM Community
- Athletic Performance
- Wellness Coaching
- Professional Development

## Core Certifications

- [NASM Certified Personal Trainer (CPT)](https://www.nasm.org/products/matrix/cpt-pdp/cpt-main-pdp): NASM's flagship personal training certification program for launching a fitness career
- [NASM Certified Nutrition Coach (CNC)](https://www.nasm.org/products/matrix/cnc-pdp/cnc-main-pdp): Science-backed nutrition certification for fitness professionals expanding into nutrition coaching
- [NASM Certified Wellness Coach (CWC)](https://www.nasm.org/products/matrix/cwc-pdp/cwc-main-pdp): Specialization in holistic wellness coaching with evidence-based practices
- [CPT Premium Self-Study Program](https://www.nasm.org/products/single-complex/cpt-premium-self-study-program/CPT7436K): Comprehensive self-paced personal trainer certification program variant

## Specialization Programs

- [Performance Enhancement Specialization (PES)](https://www.nasm.org/products/matrix/pes-pdp/pes-main-pdp): Advanced specialization in athletic performance training and sports conditioning
- [Corrective Exercise Specialization (CES)](https://www.nasm.org/products/matrix/ces-pdp/ces-main-pdp): Movement science specialization for correcting movement dysfunction
- [Certified Sports Nutrition Coach (CSNC)](https://www.nasm.org/products/single-complex/certified-sports-nutrition-coach/CSNC301K): Performance nutrition specialization for sports and athletic populations
- [Women's Fitness Specialization](https://www.nasm.org/products/single-complex/women-s-fitness-specialization/WFS301K): Evidence-based training specialization for female client programming
- [Weight Loss Specialization](https://www.nasm.org/products/bundle/weight-loss-specialization-bogo/weight-loss-specialization-bogo): Science-backed weight management coaching specialization
- [Physique & Bodybuilding Success Pathway](https://www.nasm.org/products/bundle/physique-bodybuilding-success-bundle/physique-bodybuilding-success-bundle): Complete competition prep and physique coaching specialization
- [Stretching and Flexibility Coach](https://www.nasm.org/products/single-complex/stretching-and-flexibility-coach/SFC301K): Specialization in evidence-based stretching and flexibility programming

## Career Pathway Bundles

- [NASM Elite Trainer Pathway](https://www.nasm.org/products/bundle/nasm-elite-bundle/nasm-elite-bundle): Comprehensive professional development system combining CPT, nutrition, and specializations
- [Fitness & Nutrition Coach Pathway](https://www.nasm.org/products/bundle/nutrition-fitness-coach-bundle/nutrition-fitness-coach-bundle): Dual certification bundle combining personal training and nutrition coaching credentials
- [CPT Essentials Pathway](https://www.nasm.org/products/bundle/cpt-essentials-bundle/cpt-essentials-bundle): Entry-level bundle with essential certification tools for personal training careers
- [NASM Exclusive Pathway](https://www.nasm.org/products/bundle/exclusive-bundle/exclusive-bundle): Premium accredited fitness certification pathway for professional development

## Continuing Education

- [Understanding Weight Loss Medications (GLP-1)](https://www.nasm.org/products/single-simple/nasm-understanding-weight-loss-medications/CEU1109090): Continuing education course on GLP-1 weight loss medications for fitness trainers
- [Mindful Stress Management](https://www.nasm.org/products/single-simple/mindful-stress-management/CEU1109096): Evidence-based CEU course on stress management and mindfulness practices
- [Mindful Drinking](https://www.nasm.org/products/single-simple/mindful-drinking/CEU1109077): Continuing education course on mindful drinking practices and behavior

## Community & Resources

- [NASM In Action](https://www.nasm.org/nasm-in-action): Community stories showcasing certified NASM professionals' real-world impact and success
